title: Impact of push notifications on physical activity and sodium intake among patients with hypertension: microrandomized trial of a just-in-time adaptive intervention
core_idea: Evaluate the independent, short-term effects of tailored, microrandomized push notifications—delivered at four daily time points—on immediate physical activity (steps within 60 minutes) and subsequent lower-sodium food choices (within 24 hours) among adults with self-reported hypertension in a 6-month randomized controlled trial.
tldr: Test whether just-in-time, tailored push notifications can acutely increase physical activity and encourage lower-sodium food choices in people with hypertension.
